findings.title: Host diagnostic failure suppresses independent shared-context read
findings.evidence: shared context is acquired only after the PowerShell probe and installed-runtime acquisition succeed; the single catch throws instead of returning a scoped probe failure and independent shared context.
findings.impact: A broken/missing probe or damaged Host component prevents factory_status from exposing otherwise valid V5.2 construction/canonical state, recreating the diagnostic self-lock.
findings.required_fix: Acquire and project Host, installed runtime and shared context independently with component-local unavailable states; keep no-argument fixed-purpose semantics and four tools.
findings.required_regression: Factory status returns valid shared context when Host probe throws/times out or local installed-runtime evidence acquisition fails.

findings.title: Publisher still binds an obsolete execution-owner identity
findings.evidence: Expected identity pins generation 5, attempt 2 and old Codex thread; lines115-119 reject other identities; only ProjectId is configurable.
findings.impact: The JS projector supports rollover, but its producer rejects or relabels evidence for later legitimate task/attempt/session/generation. Scope-specific gen5 historical observation must not be represented as a universal current-owner publisher.
findings.required_fix: Bind current observation target from verified protected canonical/readback context, or explicitly separate bounded historical gen5 observation from current-owner projection. Never grant transport by owner generation.
findings.required_regression: After a canonical owner rollover, fresh protected target identity is accepted; stale identity is explicitly historical; cross-project and inconsistent components remain rejected.

findings.title: Output capture is not bounded and can block after nominal timeout
findings.evidence: ReadToEndAsync stores complete stdout/stderr in memory; truncation happens after completion. GetAwaiter().GetResult has no deadline. Descendants retaining inherited pipes can keep capture incomplete even when the parent exited, and only non-exited parents trigger taskkill.
findings.impact: High output can exhaust the SYSTEM broker memory; retained pipes can stall its serial queue and health publishing indefinitely despite timeoutSeconds.
findings.required_fix: Stream bounded retained output with incremental total-byte/hash accounting; enforce an overall capture deadline and tree cleanup/cancel with explicit unknown effect when cleanup cannot be confirmed. Preserve existing capability, timeout shape and receipts.
findings.required_regression: High-volume stdout/stderr stays within memory/storage bounds; a parent exiting while a child retains pipes cannot exceed bounded completion/cancel deadline.

findings.title: Execution receipts do not establish crash-durable same-source completion
findings.evidence: Write-AtomicJson uses WriteAllText and Move-Item with no Flush(true), receipt digest or same-source readback. Invoke-BrokerPowerShell uses it at lines124-125 after effects have occurred.
findings.impact: A reported completed operation can lose durable receipt on crash/power loss, leaving an executed effect without reliable readback and inviting unsafe retry.
findings.required_fix: Use durable flush, final exact-byte readback/digest and explicit receipt persistence result before reporting completion. Persist intent/unknown-effect handling for effect/receipt failure; do not blind replay.
findings.required_regression: Injected failure after effect but before receipt acknowledgement remains unknown until exact receipt readback; successful completion has durable exact-source receipt.

findings.title: Fixed construction snapshot cannot discover subsequent integrated work
findings.evidence: Reader loads CURRENT and local-work-index only from the fixed shared-construction branch. Fresh exact fa1d9c00 CURRENT still names PR381/PR377 baseline and historical work snapshot; no progress locator/subsequent receipt-chain is consumed.
findings.impact: Real Web or new Session can read V5.2 architecture but cannot find current PR385/PR386/PR387 progress, results or continuing READY work without manual handoff.
findings.required_fix: Read a stable noncanonical single-writer CAS progress locator and exact receipt/index identities separately from frozen architecture/source documents. Do not edit a source candidate to bind its own head and do not mutate canonical CP200.
findings.required_regression: Publish a new bounded progress receipt, then a cold consumer discovers it through the stable locator without user copying a prompt; historical snapshot remains historical.

findings.title: Tests require the stale implementation instead of qualification behavior
findings.evidence: Candidate test requires exact donor helper normalized hash and ReadToEndAsync. Publisher test separately requires gen5 and old owner principal at lines93-95.
findings.impact: Correct bounded capture/current-target fixes would fail the current suite, encouraging source churn or retaining the defects.
findings.required_fix: Preserve donor baseline as historical lineage and verify candidate semantic capability parity through behavior, bounds, cancellation, fresh identity binding and exact package hashes.
